an3.77:1.1: 78 athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.77:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhavo hotīti.
an3.77:2.1: kāmadhātuvepakkañca ānanda kammaṃ nābhavissa api nu kho kāmabhavo paññāyethāti.
an3.77:2.3: iti kho ānanda kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ taṇhā sineho
an3.77:2.4: avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ hīnāya dhātuyā cetanā patiṭṭhitā patthanā patiṭṭhitā evaṃ āyatiṃpunabbhavābhinibbatti hoti
an3.77:3.1: rūpadhātuvepakkañca ānanda kammaṃ nābhavissa api nu kho rūpabhavo paññāyethāti.
an3.77:3.3: iti kho ānanda kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ taṇhā sineho
an3.77:3.4: avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ majjhimāya dhātuyā cetanā patiṭṭhitā patthanā patiṭṭhitā evaṃ āyatiṃpunabbhavābhinibbatti hoti
an3.77:4.1: arūpadhātuvepakkañca ānanda kammaṃ nābhavissa api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethāti.
an3.77:4.3: iti kho ānanda kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ taṇhā sineho
an3.77:4.4: avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ paṇītāya dhātuyā cetanā patiṭṭhitā patthanā patiṭṭhitā evaṃ āyatiṃpunabbhavābhinibbatti hoti
